title: Topo backgrounds light and dark mode
summary:
**Hover-to-remove bug fixed and dispatched:** ✕ now only shows when swatch is the *currently selected* background; unselected tiles show normal click-to-select hover (fixes data-loss risk). Animation-sync retry queued (diagnosed root cause: swatch content and border scale independently, creating two non-concentric rings instead of one).

**Two critical bugs now running, top priority:**

1. **Infinite-tab-spawn (dispatched now):** Typing URL/search in a second window causes Meridian to endlessly create tabs — likely a tab/window listener in `background.js` re-triggering itself due to broken window-id tracking for window #2+.

2. **Settings not syncing across windows (queued next):** New window doesn't reflect settings changed in another window — suspect each window reads settings once at load without listening to `chrome.storage.onChanged`.

Also queued: search-engine reorder (Google > Bing > DuckDuckGo > Brave), and animation-sync retry for swatch scaling. All pending same-file collisions clearing.
